welcomeMessage: This website is provided as a public service by the City of Belmont Police Department. In an effort to protect victim privacy, this website does not provide information regarding juvenile offenders or specific information regarding calls for service or cases that are sensitive in nature. The Belmont Police Department does not guarantee the accuracy, completeness or timeliness of the information contained on this website regarding specific incidents, crimes or people. The site may not immediately reflect information that has been filed or is pending with a court of competent jurisdiction relating to criminal offenses. With regard to the people listed on the arrest page, arrests shown are generated by arrests made only by the Belmont Police Department and do not reflect all arrests in San Mateo County.
missingPersonsText: The Belmont Police Department is requesting your assistance in finding the individuals listed below. If you have any information regarding their whereabouts, please contact the Belmont Police Department at 650-595-7400.
stolenVehiclesText: Please do not take direct action if you see any of the stolen vehicles listed below. If you see one of the vehciles listed, please contact the Belmont Police Department at 650-595-7400 or dial 9-1-1.
arrestText: This page provides information on those individuals arrested by the Belmont Police Department during the past 30 days. All persons arrested are considered innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.
securityCameraDisclaimer:
The Belmont Police Deparment security camera registry allows residents and business owners to voluntarily register their security cameras with the Belmont Police Department. The department does not request and will not have access to the camera systems, but will be aware that a camera exists when investigating a crime in or around your neighborhood.


If a crime occurs in the vicinity of a registered security camera, investigators may use the provided contact information to request camera footage. Camera footage may be used to prove or disprove facts, exonerate or implicate persons and may include the actual crime, an approach route or an escape route. The footage may provide descriptive information or additional facts or leads that can ultimatley lead to the identification and prosecution of a suspect.
securityCameraAdditionalInfoInstructions: Please include any additional information regarding your cameras (i.e. number of cameras, retention period, directions they face or areas they cover).
securityCameraSuccessText: Thank you for submitting your camera registration. If you need to update information related to this submission please call us at 650-595-7400.
crimeStatsDisclaimer: Since June of 2021, the Belmont Police Department reports all crime data to the California Department of Justice and FBI utilizing the National Incident Based Reporting System (NIBRS). Prior to June of 2021, the Belmont PD utilized summary reporting to the FBI.
